# Configuration reference

`compliance-engine serve` (and `demo`) read their configuration from these environment variables. Empty or unset variables take the default. Invalid values stop the server at start with every error listed.

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `COMPLIANCE_LISTEN` | `:8080` | Address the HTTP server listens on. |
| `COMPLIANCE_DATABASE_URL` | (empty) | PostgreSQL connection URL. Empty selects the in-memory store: all data is lost when the process stops. |
| `COMPLIANCE_AUTO_MIGRATE` | `true` | Apply pending database migrations when the server starts. When false, the server refuses to start on a schema with pending migrations. |
| `COMPLIANCE_CATALOG_DIR` | (empty) | Directory of additional control catalogs laid out as <catalog>/<version>.yaml, loaded after the built-in catalogs. |
| `COMPLIANCE_IDENTIFIER_POLICY` | `warn` | What to do with records whose LEI, country or currency codes fail validation: warn or reject. |
| `COMPLIANCE_MAX_RECORDS` | `50000` | Maximum number of records in one ingestion batch. |
| `COMPLIANCE_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | `33554432` | Maximum HTTP request body size in bytes. |
| `COMPLIANCE_TOKENS` | (empty) | Comma-separated static API tokens as <sha256-hex>:<tenant>:<workspace>[:<role>+<role>]; without roles a token gets owner+admin. Create entries with 'compliance-engine token generate'. Required by serve unless the database holds an active stored token ('compliance-engine token create'). |
| `COMPLIANCE_TLS_CERT_FILE` | (empty) | TLS certificate file (PEM). Set together with COMPLIANCE_TLS_KEY_FILE to serve HTTPS directly; otherwise terminate TLS at a reverse proxy. |
| `COMPLIANCE_TLS_KEY_FILE` | (empty) | TLS private key file (PEM). |
| `COMPLIANCE_LICENSE_FILE` | (empty) | Commercial license file. Ignored by the open-core edition. |
| `COMPLIANCE_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | Log level: debug, info, warn or error. Logs are JSON on standard error. |
| `COMPLIANCE_RATE_LIMIT` | `600` | Requests per minute per authenticated caller (token bucket, per server process). |
| `COMPLIANCE_RATE_BURST` | `120` | Burst size of the per-caller rate limit. |
| `COMPLIANCE_AUTH_FAILURE_LIMIT` | `30` | Failed authentications per minute per client address; further requests from that address get 429 until the budget refills. |
| `COMPLIANCE_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVAL` | `false` | Let a control's owner approve their own control. Each such approval is flagged in the history and the audit log. |
| `COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE_ROOT` | (empty) | Directory whose files the engine may hash to verify file:// evidence. Empty: file evidence is verified by the customer with 'compliance-engine evidence verify'. |
| `COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE_ALLOW_NO_CHECKSUM` | `false` | Accept evidence references without a checksum (integrity no_checksum), for data carried over from systems that did not record one. Such evidence never satisfies an evidence requirement until an attested check records its checksum. |
| `COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE_FETCH_ALLOW` | (empty) | Comma-separated HTTPS hosts (host[:port]) the engine may download evidence from to verify it. Empty (default): the engine makes no outbound calls. |
| `COMPLIANCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE` | (empty) | Key-encryption key file (32 random bytes, base64; create it with 'compliance-engine keys generate', mode 0600). When set, sensitive fields, evidence locations and workflow texts are encrypted at rest with per-tenant keys. Empty: no encryption at rest (a warning is logged). |
| `COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE_STORAGE_DIR` | (empty) | Directory for evidence files uploaded through POST /api/v1/evidence/upload, stored encrypted with the tenant key (requires COMPLIANCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE). Empty: evidence is referenced only, never stored. |
| `COMPLIANCE_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | `3650` | Audit events are kept at least this many days; retention deletes only older events, from the start of each chain. |
| `COMPLIANCE_RETENTION_INTERVAL` | `24h` | How often serve applies every workspace's retention policy (Go duration such as 24h). 0 disables the job; run 'compliance-engine retention run' instead. |
| `COMPLIANCE_CONSOLE` | `true` | Serve the web console at /console. Sign-in uses local accounts ('compliance-engine user create'); the session cookie is Secure, so use HTTPS or localhost. |
| `COMPLIANCE_CONSOLE_TENANT` | (empty) | Tenant the console signs users into. Empty: the sign-in form asks for the tenant. |
| `COMPLIANCE_SESSION_IDLE` | `30m` | Console sessions end after this long without a request (Go duration, at least 1m). |
| `COMPLIANCE_SESSION_MAX` | `12h` | Console sessions end this long after sign-in, whatever the activity (Go duration, at least 1m). |
| `COMPLIANCE_DEMO` | `false` | Demo mode: on first start, create tenant demo with the sample workspace and demo users, and print their passwords once. Never enable it on a deployment holding real data. |
| `COMPLIANCE_DEMO_CONNECTED_WORKSPACE` | (empty) | Demo mode only: also prepare this second sample workspace of tenant demo for a connected host product (spec step 6), with a service token written to COMPLIANCE_DEMO_TOKEN_FILE. |
| `COMPLIANCE_DEMO_TOKEN_FILE` | (empty) | Demo mode only: file receiving the connected workspace's service token (mode 0600). An existing file is kept and no token is created. |
